label: Library

example.title: Carnegie Public Library (contributing, Fayette historic district)

brief: One-storey Carnegie library on a raised basement in tan-brown brick, in a Mission Revival mode: a big curvilinear stepped front parapet outlined in white cast stone with a small arched centre crest, a recessed entrance bay under its own arched parapet with a PUBLIC LIBRARY name panel, reached by a wide flight of steps between brick cheek walls topped by globe lamp posts. Paired tall windows either side, small multi-pane windows in the gable, basement windows; a lower later brick addition to one side, flagpole and benches.
